name: Mirare
description: Located along the shores of the Central Sea, the city is the largest and most renowned halfling community in Tanares. With the blessing of Fruitful, this place is considered the granary of Tanares, with abundant food production. The city is full of small houses for the halflings, but there is a separate district for foreigners with regularly sized houses. There is an unusual number of taverns and central squares. Even the beach has structures to be a place of entertainment. Its mayor, Aldo Cotton-Hair, constantly promotes festivities and games in the name of the feys. During some of them, it’s common for the wealthiest halflings to bring some giant fruits produced by feys’ magic to share. The larger and more imposing the fruit brought, the more prestige and status the halfling gains. Some common games: Fruit-eating. Competitors must eat the most fruits in five minutes. Each must make Constitution 15 saving throws to avoid getting full or sick. The number of successful saves in a row determines the winner, but each test increases the difficulty by 2. Fruit Dish Race. A race with a twist. Competitors must balance a dish of fruits. If any of them drops, it must restart the racing. Dexterity (Acrobatics) 15 checks to maintain balance. Failed checks result in dropping fruits. For those who succeeded, a Strength check and compare the results to determine the winner. Story Narration. The competitor who tells the most captivating story wins. First, it must make an DC 15 Intelligence check to think of good elements. Then, make a Charisma (Performance) check, having advantage in case of a successful Intelligence check. The winner is the competitor who gets the biggest number in the last test.
